files: resource/set/stuff/explosive/<name>[.mine], med/, capacity/, content/, head/ (+ helmet/headgear.pattern), body/ (+ overcoat.pattern), special/ (+ flag.pattern), melee/ (+ knife/sword.pattern)

groups.name: What it is and what it copies

vars.where: file name (tags from the name split on dots; .grenade/.mine add the word)
vars.plain: Name of the item.
vars.tool: gen clone (stuff + tags)

vars.where: folder set/stuff/<kind>/
vars.plain: What sort of thing: grenade (smoke, anti-personnel, anti-tank), mine or charge, medical, container, contents, helmet or cap, body armour, special tool, melee.
vars.tool: gen clone (same folder as the base)

vars.where: item file set/stuff/{grenade/<nn kind>,explosive,med,capacity,content,head,body,special,melee}/<name>[.grenade|.mine] or its pattern: root word
vars.plain: Engine kind: item (most), weapon_throwing (the throwing hand).
vars.tool: gen clone (inherits it)

vars.where: item file set/stuff/{grenade/<nn kind>,explosive,med,capacity,content,head,body,special,melee}/<name>[.grenade|.mine] or its pattern: {from "pattern x"}
vars.plain: The item or pattern this one copies (pattern throwable, grenade_ap, grenade_at, grenade_smoke, knife, helmet ...).
vars.tool: gen clone stuff

vars.where: item file set/stuff/{grenade/<nn kind>,explosive,med,capacity,content,head,body,special,melee}/<name>[.grenade|.mine] or its pattern: {tag} hand word
vars.plain: How it is held: one small item in one hand, one hand, two hands, or to_hand.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: item file set/stuff/{grenade/<nn kind>,explosive,med,capacity,content,head,body,special,melee}/<name>[.grenade|.mine] or its pattern: {tag} class words
vars.plain: What it counts as: grenade, dynamite, smoke, armor, capacity, liquid, fortification, knife, ap, big, cumulative, ic (fire).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: item file set/stuff/{grenade/<nn kind>,explosive,med,capacity,content,head,body,special,melee}/<name>[.grenade|.mine] or its pattern: {tag} flags
vars.plain: Behaviour words: dropboxed, nokeep, stackable, keepEntity, -missile, player_bonus_target.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: item file set/stuff/{grenade/<nn kind>,explosive,med,capacity,content,head,body,special,melee}/<name>[.grenade|.mine] or its pattern: {entity}
vars.plain: Model of the item (entity under entity/inventory/).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/entity, op add)

vars.where: entity/inventory/<e>/<e>.{def,mdl,ply,mtl,dds}
vars.plain: The item's model files and skin; the def includes stuff_small/stuff_grenade/stuff_mine.ext and ties back with {extender "stuff" {item}}.
vars.tool: gen clone (entity + as, copy_assets) / /art/copy / Models page

vars.where: entity def {props ..}
vars.plain: Behaviour of the thrown model: grenade (timed), grenade contact (explodes on impact), smoke.
vars.tool: gen set (def path actor/props)

vars.where: entity def {collider}
vars.plain: Collision class of the dropped or thrown model.
vars.tool: gen set (def path)

vars.where: entity/inventory/<e>/*.dds named in .mtl
vars.plain: Pictures painted on the item.
vars.tool: /art/copy or task upload

vars.where: .mdl {Extender "preview" {"Stuff" {camera} {lights}}}
vars.plain: The inventory picture is the model drawn live; this sets its camera.

vars.where: item file set/stuff/{grenade/<nn kind>,explosive,med,capacity,content,head,body,special,melee}/<name>[.grenade|.mine] or its pattern: {mass}
vars.plain: Weight.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/mass, op add)

vars.where: item file set/stuff/{grenade/<nn kind>,explosive,med,capacity,content,head,body,special,melee}/<name>[.grenade|.mine] or its pattern: {possibleDamageRadius}

vars.where: sum of all blast layers of carried items
vars.plain: Carried explosives add up to how likely a vehicle or soldier cooks off.

vars.where: interaction effects by tag (e.g. link_sound "detonation/grenade_smoke/..")
vars.plain: Explosion or hiss sound, picked by the item's class in the interaction files.

vars.where: breed {inventory {item "tags" n}}
vars.plain: Which soldiers carry it and how many.
vars.tool: gen breed set (+inventory/item)

vars.where: vehicle def {extender "inventory" {box {item "tags" n}}}
vars.plain: How many a vehicle stores.

vars.where: {extender "supply_zone" {resupply {item "tags" n}}}

vars.where: desc.lng desc/stuff/<tags> (or desc/weapon for grenades) / mod #file.lng
vars.plain: Name of the item in the game.

gaps: no op makes a new item from a like item with its numbers -> op item (name, like, kind, throw {range, angle, speed, spread}, blast layers, cumulative, size, weight, mass)
second and later blast layers ({damage add blastwave}) cannot be addressed by gen set paths -> op item field blast (layers written whole)
item model/skin/inventory picture: no op clones an inventory entity and re-points {extender "stuff" {item}} -> op stuffmodel (shared with gun)
mine arming time and props (contact fuse) live in the entity def: gen set works only once the def is in the mod -> op stuffmodel fields props, mine_time
who carries it: breed inventory lines and armour slot only via raw gen breed set -> op kit (shared with gun)
smoke length and timed grenade fuse are not item keys (shared interaction file / engine) -> no op; timed fuse needs an in-game test [T]
